name: Budget-conscious parent
description: Uses a familiar retailer name and asks whether a general vision discount applies.
query: My daughter needs new glasses and we normally buy them at Walmart. Does our dental plan help pay for the frames?

name: Retiree comparing hearing aids
description: Asks for the discount range, partner name, and advertised average savings.
query: I'm retired and shopping for hearing aids. What exactly is the member discount, who provides it, and how much do people usually save?

name: Caregiver asking about Life Alert
description: Checks activation cost, monthly discount, and extended-family eligibility.
query: I'm helping my mother choose a medical alert service. Is there a Life Alert deal, does activation cost anything, and can extended family use it?

name: Bargain shopper
description: Combines two oral-care discounts in one natural-language question.
query: Before I buy anything, can you compare the teeth-whitening and electric-toothbrush discounts and tell me which brands they apply to?

name: Fitness-focused member
description: Asks about the newly advertised fitness access in conversational wording.
query: I want to get back to the gym this year. Is there a fitness membership perk and how many locations can I use?

name: Rambling family planner
description: Mixes family context and two benefits to test multi-part evidence synthesis.
query: We're trying to plan expenses for my dad and also get healthier as a family, so I was wondering—does GEHA have anything for hearing aids, and is there some kind of gym discount too?

name: Member asking about D1110
description: Requires the plan brochure for the CDT definition and the benefits guide for plan comparison.
query: My dentist put CDT code D1110 on the estimate. How many adult cleanings do High and Standard cover each calendar year, and what is the in-network member cost?

name: Member asking about D7140
description: Combines the brochure's extraction-code definition with Class B member cost-sharing.
query: The treatment plan lists D7140 for a simple extraction. Is that service covered, and what would I pay with High versus Standard in-network?

name: Member asking about D3310
description: Tests a code-specific lifetime limitation plus High and Standard Class C cost-sharing.
query: For root canal code D3310, is there a lifetime restriction and what do High and Standard members pay in-network?

name: Retired federal employee
description: A retiree asks whether adult orthodontics is covered under Standard and what the in-network cost and lifetime maximum are.
query: I'm a retired federal employee considering braces for myself under the Standard dental plan. Are adults covered, what would I pay in-network, and what is the lifetime maximum?

name: Middle-aged member
description: A middle-aged member compares the example cost of a porcelain crown under High, Standard, and no insurance.
query: I'm 47 and my dentist says I need a porcelain crown. About what would I pay with the High plan versus Standard, and what is the average cost without insurance?

name: Parent with a child
description: A parent compares High and Standard orthodontic costs and lifetime maximums for a child's braces.
query: My 13-year-old needs braces. What would we pay in-network under the High plan versus Standard, and what is the lifetime maximum for each plan?

name: Single mom in Modesto (rambling)
description: A single parent buries a child-cleaning coverage question inside local, family, and scheduling details.
query: I'm a single mom here in Modesto, and between school pickup, soccer practice, and trying to find a dentist who can see both of us on the same afternoon, I'm getting a little overwhelmed. My daughter is due for another regular cleaning, and before I rearrange everything again, can you tell me how many cleanings per calendar year High and Standard cover and whether we pay anything in-network?
